title: The Lord's Love for Jacob and Hatred for Esau
description: The Lord assures Israel of His love by reminding them that He loved Jacob but hated Esau. When the people ask how He has loved them, the Lord points to Edom's desolation: its mountains are laid waste and its heritage has become a dwelling place for jackals. Even if Edom tries to rebuild, the Lord will tear it down, and Israel will see the Lord's greatness beyond their own borders.
